title: Riesz-Kernel Stein Variational Gradient Descent: Renormalized Entropy and Long-Time Particle Limits
summary: Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD) transports interacting particles toward a target distribution through deterministic kernelized dynamics. Singular Riesz kernels are attractive because they can provide quantitative population-level convergence, but at the finite-particle level the corresponding Stein energy has infinite self-interaction. We study periodic Riesz SVGD with self-interaction removed and prove a many-particle, long-time sampling theorem.
